name: Sync Fork with Upstream
description: Synchronize this fork with the upstream repository while preserving local commits. Uses rebase and force‑with‑lease push.

steps.name: Checkout branch
steps.description: Ensure working on target branch (default current).

steps.name: Fetch upstream
steps.description: Retrieve latest commits from upstream remote.

steps.name: Rebase onto upstream
steps.description: Reapply local commits on top of upstream's branch.

steps.name: Push rebased branch
steps.description: Update fork on GitHub with rebased history.
